title.zh-CN: 反复咯血与逐渐憋气 · 42岁女性
title.en: Recurrent haemoptysis and progressive breathlessness · 42-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位女性多年来断断续续痰中带血，近半年越来越憋气：判断她的呼吸受限出在哪里、怎样安全地查明原因，再沿着记录的病程复盘。
summary.en: A woman who has coughed up streaks of blood on and off for years is now increasingly breathless: work out where her breathing is limited and how to find the cause safely, then follow her recorded course.

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——42岁女性；间断咯血 10 年（痰中带血，约每年 1 次），憋气半年、近 1 个月加重，近 1 个月再次咯血；能平卧，此次无发热，食欲和精神好、体重无明显变化；既往体检发现心律不齐、未治疗；不吸烟不饮酒，接触过含氯清洁剂；查体双肺呼吸音粗、无干湿啰音、叩诊清音、气管居中，无杵状指、下肢水肿或浅表淋巴结肿大；胸部 CT、肺功能、频发室早和短阵室速、LVEF 60%、尿蛋白阴性、肝肾功能正常；支气管镜所见、活检病理（刚果红阳性、λ 强阳性）、血尿免疫固定电泳无单克隆条带、未行骨髓检查；多次硬质支气管镜、电烧灼和冷冻治疗，以及气管切开和全身药物，7 个月后拔除气切套管、FEV₁ 升至 1.71 L，11 个月时无憋气和咯血——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段设计、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；1.0.0 版没有记录的内容（生命体征、血氧、出血量、血常规和凝血、游离轻链、心脏标志物、组织分型、心脏影像细节、各项治疗的时间和细节）保持未知。两处只能保留原样、留待核对：全身药物只在 1.0.0 版的教学文本中提及美法仑和沙利度胺（“历史联合化疗”），方案、剂量和疗程没有记录；“7 个月”和“11 个月”从何时算起没有记录。原报告的图 1 已获准在本地展示，只附在病例结束后的结局记录中。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 42-year-old woman; intermittent haemoptysis for ten years (blood-streaked sputum, about once a year), breathlessness for six months, worse over the last month, with haemoptysis again in that month; able to lie flat, no fever this time, appetite and energy good, no clear weight change; an irregular heart rhythm found at an earlier check-up and never treated; no smoking or alcohol, exposure to chlorine-based cleaning products; on examination coarse breath sounds without wheezes or crackles, resonant percussion, a central trachea, no clubbing, leg oedema or enlarged superficial nodes; the chest CT, lung function, frequent ventricular premature beats with short runs of ventricular tachycardia, LVEF 60 %, negative urine protein and normal liver and renal function; the bronchoscopic findings, the biopsy (Congo red positive, strongly λ positive), serum and urine immunofixation without a monoclonal band, no bone marrow examination; repeated rigid bronchoscopy, electrocautery and cryotherapy, a tracheostomy and systemic drugs, decannulation after 7 months with FEV₁ rising to 1.71 L, and no breathlessness or haemoptysis at 11 months — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what 1.0.0 does not record (vital signs, oxygen saturation, the amount of bleeding, blood count and clotting, free light chains, cardiac biomarkers, tissue typing, cardiac imaging detail, the timing and detail of each treatment) stays unknown. Two points are kept as recorded and listed for checking: the systemic drugs are named only in 1.0.0's teaching text, as melphalan and thalidomide ('historical combination chemotherapy'), with no regimen, doses or duration; and what the 7 and 11 months are counted from is not recorded. The report's figure 1 is approved for local display and is attached only to the outcome record shown after the case.

disclaimer.en: Historical case review for clinical education, not for individual care or self-medication. The course and results come from the report; unrecorded physiological changes are not simulated.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 从流量–容积环和弥散量定位气流阻塞：把弥散量正常的固定性上气道阻塞图形识别为中心气道阻塞，并用影像和内镜去证实（ERS/ATS 2022）。
learningOutcomes.en: Localise airflow obstruction from the flow–volume loop and gas transfer, recognising a fixed upper-airway pattern with a preserved diffusing capacity as central-airway obstruction for imaging and endoscopy to confirm (ERS/ATS 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 安全地安排严重狭窄、近期咯血的气道的取材：先查血常规、凝血和妊娠状态，再在全身麻醉下由介入呼吸团队备硬质支气管镜、止血手段和心电监护进行（中华医学会呼吸病学分会良性中心气道狭窄专家共识，2017）。
learningOutcomes.en: Arrange tissue sampling of a severely narrowed airway that has recently bled, safely — blood count, clotting and pregnancy status first, then general anaesthesia with the interventional team, a rigid bronchoscope, bleeding control and ECG monitoring (Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis, 2017).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 解读气道活检的刚果红和轻链染色，并说出判定局限性 AL 淀粉样变之前还需要的证据：组织质谱分型、血尿免疫固定电泳加血清游离轻链、骨髓检查和器官评估（中国系统性轻链型淀粉样变性诊断和治疗指南，2021）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret Congo red and light-chain staining of an airway biopsy and state what else is needed before calling AL amyloid localised: typing by mass spectrometry, serum and urine immunofixation with free light chains, a marrow examination and organ assessment (Chinese AL amyloidosis guideline, 2021).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对淀粉样变患者的频发室性早搏和短阵室速评估心脏受累，即使左心室射血分数正常（ESC 2021 心脏淀粉样变立场声明；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess frequent ventricular ectopy and non-sustained ventricular tachycardia in a patient with amyloid for cardiac involvement, even with a normal ejection fraction (ESC 2021 position statement on cardiac amyloidosis; ESC 2022 ventricular arrhythmias).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 为局限性气道淀粉样变选择局部治疗——分次硬质支气管镜再通，复发时考虑外照射放疗——并把全身化疗留给确诊的系统性 AL（BSH 2015；EHA-ISA 2023）。
learningOutcomes.en: Choose local treatment for localised airway amyloidosis — staged rigid bronchoscopic recanalisation, external-beam radiotherapy for recurrence — and keep chemotherapy for proven systemic AL (BSH 2015; EHA-ISA 2023).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把报告当年同时使用的硬质支气管镜治疗、气管切开和全身药物与现行做法对照，并说明单个病例为何无法判断哪一项治疗起了作用。
learningOutcomes.en: Contrast the reported course — rigid bronchoscopic treatment, a tracheostomy and systemic drugs together — with current practice, and explain why a single report cannot show which treatment worked.

triageNote.zh-CN: 42岁女性，间断咯血 10 年、憋气半年，近 1 个月憋气加重并再次咯血，收入病房。能平卧，此次无发热。
triageNote.en: 42-year-old woman admitted with ten years of intermittent haemoptysis and six months of breathlessness, worse over the past month, when the haemoptysis has returned. She can lie flat and has had no fever this time.

personality.zh-CN: 42岁女性，断断续续咳血已有好多年，这半年喘得越来越厉害，想住院查个明白。回答问题有条理、简短；只说自己清楚的事，不清楚就直说说不上来，从不猜测。
personality.en: A 42-year-old woman who has put up with coughing blood on and off for years and is now in hospital because her breathing has been getting harder for six months; she wants to know what is wrong. She answers clearly and briefly, says only what she knows, and when she doesn't know she says so and never guesses.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 口语、短句，不用医学术语。
speechStyle.en: Plain, short sentences; no medical terms.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，我这些年老是断断续续咳血，这半年又越来越憋气。
openingLine.en: Doctor, I've been coughing up blood on and off for years, and for the last six months I've been getting more and more short of breath.

concerns.zh-CN: 我就想弄清楚到底是什么病，还能不能把这口气喘顺。
concerns.en: I just want to know what this is, and whether I'll ever breathe properly again.

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：她有些紧张，但说话清楚；不主动提任何检查结果或数字，不编造病史、用药、过敏或月经情况。到随访阶段她明显放松了。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: she is a little anxious but speaks clearly; she never volunteers test results or numbers, and never invents history, medicines, allergies or anything about her periods. At follow-up she is visibly more relaxed.

description.zh-CN: 她因间断咯血 10 年、憋气半年并在近 1 个月加重而收入病房：采集病史并查体，调阅胸部 CT、肺功能和心脏方面的记录，判断问题所在，再安排下一步检查，并保证这一步是安全的。
description.en: She has been admitted with ten years of intermittent haemoptysis and six months of breathlessness that has worsened over the past month: take the history, examine her, read her chest CT, lung function and heart records, decide where the problem lies, and arrange the next test so that it is safe.

description.zh-CN: 她已经做了支气管镜检查，检查记录和活检病理已在病历中：读懂它们，并决定还需要哪些评估。
description.en: She has had her bronchoscopy, and its record and the biopsy report are in her notes: interpret them and decide what further assessment she needs.

description.zh-CN: 进一步评估的结果已部分回报：调阅它们，补开仍缺的检查，制订治疗计划并付诸行动。
description.en: Part of the further assessment has come back: read it, order what is still missing, and set her treatment plan in motion.

description.zh-CN: 她回到随访门诊：问问她现在的情况，并查阅报告记录的治疗经过与结局（11 个月以后的情况没有记录）。
description.en: She is back in the follow-up clinic: ask how she is now and review the treatment and outcome the report records (nothing after 11 months is recorded).

name.zh-CN: 报告记录的病程与结局

text.zh-CN: 报告记录的治疗：多次硬质支气管镜、电烧灼和冷冻治疗，曾行气管切开，并使用全身药物（以联合化疗的形式，提及美法仑和沙利度胺；方案、剂量和疗程没有记录）。7 个月后拔除气管切开套管，FEV₁ 升至 1.71 L；11 个月时无呼吸困难和咯血，能从事轻体力活动。多种治疗同时进行，无法区分各自的效果。
text.en: Treatment recorded in the report: repeated rigid bronchoscopy, electrocautery and cryotherapy, a tracheostomy, and systemic drugs (given as combination chemotherapy, with melphalan and thalidomide named; the regimen, doses and duration are not recorded). The tracheostomy tube was removed after 7 months and FEV₁ rose to 1.71 L; at 11 months she had no breathlessness or haemoptysis and could manage light physical activity. Because several treatments were combined, their separate effects cannot be told apart.

note.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录“7 个月”和“11 个月”从何时算起、各项治疗的先后和次数、电烧灼和冷冻是否经硬质支气管镜进行、气管切开的原因、并发症、心律失常的处理，以及 11 个月以后的情况。
note.en: This case does not record what the 7 and 11 months are counted from, the order and number of the treatments, whether the electrocautery and cryotherapy were given through the rigid bronchoscope, why the tracheostomy was done, complications, how the arrhythmia was managed, or anything after 11 months.

name.zh-CN: 转介入呼吸团队：全身麻醉下支气管镜检查（备硬质支气管镜）
name.en: Interventional pulmonology referral: bronchoscopy under general anaesthesia, rigid bronchoscope ready

dose.zh-CN: 由介入呼吸医生和麻醉医生在手术室或介入室实施：全身麻醉，备好硬质支气管镜和喷射通气、吸引及止血手段，持续心电监护并备除颤仪；气道有保障后再取活检。转介前先查血常规、凝血功能和妊娠状态。
dose.en: Done by the interventional pulmonologist with an anaesthetist in theatre or the interventional suite: general anaesthesia with a rigid bronchoscope and jet ventilation ready, suction and means to stop bleeding, continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator; biopsies only once the airway is secured. Check the blood count, clotting and pregnancy status before referring.

response.zh-CN: 介入呼吸团队和麻醉医生接收了转介，安排在全身麻醉下行支气管镜检查。本病例没有记录她的第一次支气管镜具体是怎样做的；检查记录在病例的下一阶段给出。
response.en: The interventional pulmonology team and an anaesthetist accept the referral and plan bronchoscopy under general anaesthesia. This case does not record how her first bronchoscopy was actually done; its record opens in the next part of the case.

name.zh-CN: 内镜室清醒镇静下可弯曲支气管镜钳夹活检
name.en: Flexible bronchoscopy with forceps biopsies under conscious sedation in the endoscopy suite

dose.zh-CN: 在内镜室行可弯曲支气管镜：咪达唑仑清醒镇静，鼻导管吸氧，指脉氧监测，经镜钳夹多块活检。
dose.en: Flexible bronchoscopy in the endoscopy suite: midazolam conscious sedation, nasal oxygen and pulse oximetry, several forceps biopsies through the scope.

harm.zh-CN: 她的气管和多处大支气管广泛狭窄，流量–容积环为固定性上气道阻塞，近 1 个月还在咯血：镇静会削弱维持狭窄气道开放的自主呼吸，可弯曲镜本身可能堵住残余的管腔，活检引起的出血或水肿可在几分钟内造成窒息，而内镜室没有硬质支气管镜和喷射通气可以抢救。中华医学会呼吸病学分会 2017 年良性中心气道狭窄介入诊治专家共识主张严重中心气道狭窄在全身麻醉下、由备好硬质支气管镜的介入团队处理。
harm.en: Her trachea and multiple large bronchi are widely narrowed, the flow–volume loop shows a fixed upper-airway obstruction, and she has been bleeding this past month: sedation can remove the breathing effort that holds a narrowed airway open, the flexible scope itself may occlude what lumen remains, and bleeding or swelling after a biopsy can cause asphyxia within minutes, with no rigid bronchoscope or jet ventilation in the endoscopy suite to rescue her. The Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on bronchoscopic management of benign central airway stenosis (2017) manages severe central narrowing under general anaesthesia by an interventional team with a rigid bronchoscope ready.

response.zh-CN: 已为她预约内镜室的可弯曲支气管镜。本病例没有记录这样做，也不模拟其后果；接下来的检查记录按报告的实际病程给出。
response.en: She is booked for flexible bronchoscopy in the endoscopy suite. This case does not record this and does not simulate what would follow; the records that come next show the course as reported.

name.zh-CN: 经验性四联抗结核治疗

dose.zh-CN: 异烟肼、利福平、吡嗪酰胺和乙胺丁醇每日口服，按体重给药（强化期）。
dose.en: Isoniazid, rifampicin, pyrazinamide and ethambutol by mouth daily, dosed by weight (intensive phase).

harm.zh-CN: 结核病要靠标本诊断：痰涂片抗酸染色、核酸扩增检测和分枝杆菌培养，痰液不能明确时再取支气管镜标本（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 结核病诊断指南）。她病程十年、此次无发热，没有理由在留取标本之前就开始治疗；数月经验性四联抗结核治疗会带来肝毒性等风险，并推迟对管壁病变真正性质的诊断。
harm.en: Tuberculosis is diagnosed from samples — sputum smear microscopy, a nucleic-acid amplification test and mycobacterial culture, with bronchoscopic sampling when sputum does not give the answer (ATS/IDSA/CDC tuberculosis diagnosis guideline, 2017). Nothing in her ten-year course, without fever this time, calls for treatment before those samples are taken, and months of empirical four-drug treatment expose her to hepatotoxicity and delay finding out what the wall disease really is.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录抗结核治疗，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no anti-tuberculosis treatment and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 吸入糖皮质激素–福莫特罗（按哮喘治疗）

dose.zh-CN: 布地奈德–福莫特罗吸入剂，规律吸入并按需加用（哮喘方案）。
dose.en: Budesonide–formoterol inhaler, regular and as-needed doses (asthma regimen).

harm.zh-CN: 哮喘的诊断需要证明呼气气流受限是可变的；流量–容积环的固定性上气道阻塞图形和 CT 上增厚、钙化的气管支气管壁都不是哮喘的表现（ERS/ATS 2022 肺功能解读技术标准）。按哮喘用药打不开固定的中心气道狭窄，只会推迟病因诊断。
harm.en: Asthma requires airflow limitation shown to be variable; a fixed upper-airway pattern on the flow–volume loop and thickened, calcified tracheobronchial walls on CT are not features of asthma (ERS/ATS technical standard on interpreting lung function, 2022). Asthma inhalers cannot open a fixed central narrowing; they only delay the diagnosis.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录吸入治疗，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no inhaled treatment and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 吸氧（仅在血氧饱和度低于目标时）
name.en: Oxygen (only if the saturation is below target)

dose.zh-CN: 先测经皮血氧饱和度；只有低于目标范围时才经鼻导管给氧，并滴定到目标范围。
dose.en: Measure SpO₂ first; give nasal-cannula oxygen only if it is below the target range, titrated to that range.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录她的血氧饱和度，也没有记录是否吸氧；不模拟其效果。吸氧解除不了固定的气道狭窄。
response.en: This case records neither her oxygen saturation nor whether oxygen was given; it does not simulate its effect. Oxygen does not relieve a fixed airway narrowing.

name.zh-CN: 请心内科评估室性心律失常
name.en: Cardiology review of the ventricular arrhythmia

dose.zh-CN: 请心内科评估频发室早和短阵室速：查血钾、血镁、NT-proBNP 和肌钙蛋白，行含应变分析的超声心动图或心脏磁共振，寻找结构性（包括浸润性）心脏病，并就麻醉期间的监护提出意见。
dose.en: Ask cardiology to assess the frequent ventricular ectopy and short runs of VT: potassium, magnesium, NT-proBNP and troponin, echocardiography with strain or cardiac MRI to look for structural (including infiltrative) heart disease, and advice on monitoring during anaesthesia.

response.zh-CN: 心内科会来会诊。本病例没有记录心内科评估或心律失常的处理，不模拟其结果。
response.en: Cardiology will see her. This case records no cardiology assessment or treatment of the arrhythmia and does not simulate one.

name.zh-CN: 请血液科评估活检结果
name.en: Haematology referral to assess the biopsy findings

dose.zh-CN: 请血液科会诊，评估活检结果并指导之后的全身评估。
dose.en: Ask haematology to review the biopsy findings and guide the systemic assessment that follows.

response.zh-CN: 血液科接受会诊。本病例没有记录血液科的会诊意见；已有的检查结果会随病例进展出现在记录中，其余不作模拟。
response.en: Haematology accepts the referral. This case records no haematology opinion; the results that exist appear in the records as the case goes on, and nothing else is simulated.

name.zh-CN: 硬质支气管镜下气道再通（电烧灼、冷冻），按需分次进行
name.en: Rigid bronchoscopic recanalisation (electrocautery, cryotherapy), staged as needed

dose.zh-CN: 全身麻醉下由介入呼吸团队实施：硬质镜机械清除，配合电烧灼和冷冻恢复管腔，按病变范围分次进行。
dose.en: Under general anaesthesia by the interventional team: mechanical debulking with the rigid bronchoscope, with electrocautery and cryotherapy to restore the lumen, staged over several sessions according to the extent of disease.

response.zh-CN: 已与介入团队预约。报告记录她接受了多次硬质支气管镜、电烧灼和冷冻治疗；本病例没有记录治疗次数、间隔、具体方式和并发症，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: Booked with the interventional team. The report records repeated rigid bronchoscopy, electrocautery and cryotherapy; this case does not record their number, intervals, technique or complications and does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 气管切开

dose.zh-CN: 外科或经皮气管切开，置入气管切开套管。
dose.en: Surgical or percutaneous tracheostomy with a tracheostomy tube.

response.zh-CN: 报告记录她在病程中做过气管切开；本病例没有记录切开的时间和原因，不模拟其效果。气管切开只能绕过造口以上的气道。
response.en: The report records a tracheostomy during her course; this case does not record when or why it was done and does not simulate its effect. A tracheostomy bypasses only the airway above the stoma.

name.zh-CN: 转放疗科评估气道外照射放疗
name.en: Radiotherapy referral for external-beam treatment of the airway

dose.zh-CN: 请放疗科评估受累气道的低剂量外照射放疗，用于病变弥漫或再通后复发时。
dose.en: Ask clinical oncology to assess low-dose external-beam radiotherapy to the affected airway, for diffuse disease or recurrence after recanalisation.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录是否考虑过或做过放疗，不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case does not record whether radiotherapy was considered or given and does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 全身联合化疗（以烷化剂为基础）

dose.zh-CN: 口服烷化剂联合免疫调节药，按方案分周期给药（剂量按体表面积计算；免疫调节药须在妊娠预防计划内使用）。
dose.en: An oral alkylating agent with an immunomodulatory drug in cycles, per protocol (doses by body surface area; the immunomodulatory drug only within a pregnancy-prevention programme).

harm.zh-CN: 她的记录里没有任何需要化疗的诊断依据：只局限于气道的淀粉样变（局限性 AL）用局部治疗，不用化疗（BSH 2015 AL 淀粉样变治疗指南）；即使确诊系统性 AL，现行一线方案也是达雷妥尤单抗联合硼替佐米、环磷酰胺和地塞米松（EHA-ISA 2023），而不是美法仑联合沙利度胺。美法仑有骨髓毒性，可致卵巢功能衰竭和继发白血病；沙利度胺致畸——可能怀孕的女性必须纳入妊娠预防计划——还可引起周围神经病和静脉血栓。
harm.en: Nothing in her records establishes a disease that needs chemotherapy: amyloid confined to the airway (localised AL) is treated locally, not with chemotherapy (BSH AL management guideline, 2015), and even proven systemic AL is now treated first with daratumumab, bortezomib, cyclophosphamide and dexamethasone (EHA-ISA 2023), not melphalan with thalidomide. Melphalan is myelotoxic and can cause ovarian failure and secondary leukaemia; thalidomide is teratogenic — a pregnancy-prevention programme is mandatory in a woman who could become pregnant — and causes neuropathy and venous thrombosis.

response.zh-CN: 报告记录她在病程中使用过全身药物（以联合化疗的形式，提及美法仑和沙利度胺；方案、剂量和疗程没有记录）；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The report records systemic drug treatment during her course (combination chemotherapy, with melphalan and thalidomide named; regimen, doses and duration not recorded); this case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 气管及双侧主支气管置入自膨式金属支架
name.en: Self-expanding metallic stents in the trachea and both main bronchi

dose.zh-CN: 在支气管镜下沿气管和双侧主支气管放置自膨式金属支架。
dose.en: Bronchoscopic placement of self-expanding metallic stents along the trachea and both main bronchi.

harm.zh-CN: 非恶性气道狭窄放置金属支架是最后的手段：肉芽增生、支架断裂、移位和取出困难都很常见，美国 FDA 2005 年关于良性气道疾病使用金属气管支架的公共卫生通告要求先充分考虑其他办法，2017 年良性中心气道狭窄专家共识（中华医学会呼吸病学分会）也主张有其他办法时不用。她的狭窄范围广，病变还可能再长，长段支架代替不了分次再通。
harm.en: In non-malignant airway narrowing metallic stents are a last resort: granulation, fracture, migration and very difficult removal are common, so the US FDA's public health notification on metallic tracheal stents in benign airway disorders (2005) reserves them for when other options have been explored, as does the Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis (2017). Her narrowing is extensive and can regrow, so long stents cannot replace staged recanalisation.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录支架置入，也不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no stenting and does not simulate its effect.

title.zh-CN: 问清咳血与憋气的经过并查体
title.en: Take the bleeding and breathlessness history and examine her

hint.zh-CN: 咳血和憋气各自是怎样发展的？哪些伴随表现和体征能帮你判断问题在大气道、小气道、肺实质还是心脏？
hint.en: How has each symptom — the bleeding and the breathlessness — developed, and which associated features and signs would help you decide whether the problem lies in the large airways, the small airways, the lung tissue or the heart?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清咳血的规律和最近的变化、憋气何时开始和加重、能否平卧、有无发热，再听诊、叩诊双肺，检查气管位置、手指和淋巴结。
guidance.en: At the bedside, establish the pattern of the bleeding and how it has changed, when the breathlessness began and worsened, whether she can lie flat and whether she has a fever; then listen to and percuss her chest and check her trachea, fingers and lymph nodes.

title.zh-CN: 读懂胸部 CT 和肺功能
title.en: Make sense of the chest CT and lung function

hint.zh-CN: 流量–容积环的哪一部分告诉你阻塞的位置？弥散量正常又补充了什么？CT 上的异常在管腔里、管壁上，还是肺实质里？
hint.en: Which part of the flow–volume loop tells you where the obstruction is, and what does a normal diffusing capacity add? Is the CT abnormality in the lumen, in the wall or in the lung tissue?

guidance.zh-CN: 在病历终端调阅胸部 CT 和肺功能报告，然后到会诊板作答决策 1。
guidance.en: Read the chest CT and lung function reports at a records terminal, then answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.zh-CN: 安排下一步检查并保证安全
title.en: Plan the next test and keep her safe

hint.zh-CN: 如果这条气道在操作中被血块或器械堵住，谁、用什么能在几分钟内把它重新打开？她的心律记录又提醒你在旁边准备什么？
hint.en: If this airway were blocked by blood or an instrument during a procedure, who could reopen it, and with what, within minutes? And what does her rhythm record tell you to have ready?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅心律记录和射血分数记录，核查血常规、凝血和妊娠状态，作答决策 2，然后把计划付诸行动——转介或预约你选择的支气管镜方式。行动之后，病例才进入下一阶段。
guidance.en: Read her rhythm and ejection fraction records, check her blood count, clotting and pregnancy status, answer decision 2, then act on your plan — the referral or booking for the bronchoscopy you chose. The case moves on once you have acted.

hint.zh-CN: 这份病理结果证明了什么，又留下了什么悬而未决？要判断病变只在气道还是累及全身，你还缺哪几类证据？
hint.en: What does this biopsy result prove, and what does it leave open? To decide whether the disease is confined to the airway or affects the whole body, which kinds of evidence are you still missing?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅支气管镜检查记录和气道活检病理，需要时请血液科会诊，然后作答决策 3。
guidance.en: Read the bronchoscopy record and the airway biopsy report, involve haematology if you think it necessary, then answer decision 3.

title.zh-CN: 补齐评估并制订治疗计划
title.en: Complete the assessment and plan her treatment

hint.zh-CN: 现有结果足以说明病变只在气道吗？什么情况下全身治疗才有依据？最窄的那段气道现在需要什么？
hint.en: Do the results so far show the disease is confined to the airway? When would systemic treatment be justified — and what does the narrowest segment of her airway need now?

guidance.zh-CN: 调阅免疫固定电泳、骨髓检查、尿蛋白和肝肾功能的结果，开出仍缺的检查，作答决策 4，并把治疗计划付诸行动（预约或转介你选择的治疗）。
guidance.en: Read the immunofixation, bone marrow, urine protein and liver and kidney results, order what is still missing, answer decision 4 and act on your plan (book or refer for the treatment you chose).

title.zh-CN: 回顾记录的病程与结局
title.en: Review her recorded course and outcome

hint.zh-CN: 报告里同时用了好几种治疗：你能从中判断是哪一项起了作用吗？
hint.en: The report combined several treatments: can you tell from it which one worked?

guidance.zh-CN: 在随访门诊问问她现在的情况，再调阅报告记录的治疗经过与结局。
guidance.en: At the follow-up clinic, ask how she is now, then read the treatment and outcome the report records.

prompt.zh-CN: 她断续痰中带血 10 年，憋气半年、近 1 个月加重，此次无发热；双肺呼吸音粗，无干、湿啰音。胸部 CT：气管及多处大支气管管壁不规则增厚、钙化，管腔广泛不均匀狭窄，右肺上叶节段性肺不张。肺功能：流量–容积环呈固定性上气道阻塞图形，FEV₁ 1.45 L（占预计值 55.7%），FEV₁/FVC 50.77%，弥散量占预计值 89.4%。你最支持哪种判断和下一步？
prompt.en: Ten years of intermittent blood-streaked sputum, six months of breathlessness that has worsened over the past month, no fever this time; coarse breath sounds without wheezes or crackles. Chest CT: irregular thickening and calcification of the walls of the trachea and multiple large bronchi, with widespread uneven narrowing and segmental atelectasis in the right upper lobe. Lung function: a fixed upper-airway obstruction pattern on the flow–volume loop, FEV₁ 1.45 L (55.7 % of predicted), FEV₁/FVC 50.77 %, diffusing capacity 89.4 % of predicted. Which interpretation and next step do you favour?

need.zh-CN: 先问清咳血和憋气的经过，听诊双肺，并调阅胸部 CT 和肺功能报告。
need.en: First establish the course of the bleeding and the breathlessness, listen to her lungs, and read the chest CT and lung function reports.

text.zh-CN: 固定性中心气道阻塞，病变在气管支气管壁本身；下一步做支气管镜，直视病变并取活检
text.en: Fixed central-airway obstruction from disease of the tracheobronchial wall itself; next, bronchoscopy to inspect it and take biopsies

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。吸气和呼气两支同时出现平台的固定性上气道阻塞图形，加上正常的弥散量，把阻塞定位在中心气道，而不是小气道或肺实质；CT 显示病变就在气管支气管壁上。ERS/ATS 2022 肺功能解读技术标准把流量–容积环的形态当作提示中心气道阻塞、需要进一步证实的线索，而不是诊断；管壁病变的性质只能靠支气管镜直视和活检来明确。
feedback.en: Correct. A fixed upper-airway pattern — plateaus in both inspiration and expiration — with a preserved diffusing capacity puts the obstruction in the central airway rather than the small airways or the lung tissue, and the CT shows the disease in the tracheobronchial wall itself. The ERS/ATS 2022 technical standard on interpreting lung function treats the loop's shape as a pointer to central obstruction that needs confirming, not as a diagnosis; only bronchoscopic inspection and biopsy can name the wall disease.

text.zh-CN: 含氯清洁剂诱发的刺激性哮喘；先用吸入糖皮质激素–福莫特罗，1 个月后复查肺功能看反应
text.en: Irritant-induced asthma from the chlorine cleaning products; start an inhaled corticosteroid–formoterol and repeat lung function after a month

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。哮喘需要证明气流受限是可变的，而固定性上气道阻塞图形和 CT 上增厚、钙化的气管支气管壁都不能用哮喘解释；她也没有干啰音。按 ERS/ATS 2022 肺功能解读技术标准，FEV₁/FVC 降低只说明存在阻塞，阻塞的部位要看流量–容积环的形态。含氯清洁剂接触值得记录，但先按哮喘用药只会推迟病因诊断。
feedback.en: No. Asthma needs airflow limitation shown to be variable, and neither a fixed upper-airway pattern nor thickened, calcified tracheobronchial walls on CT is explained by it; she has no wheeze either. Under the ERS/ATS 2022 interpretive standard a low FEV₁/FVC shows that obstruction exists, while the shape of the flow–volume loop shows where it is. The chlorine exposure is worth recording, but treating asthma first only delays finding the cause.

text.zh-CN: 气管支气管结核伴钙化性狭窄；先开始四联抗结核治疗，2 个月后复查胸部 CT
text.en: Tracheobronchial tuberculosis with calcified stenosis; start four-drug anti-tuberculosis treatment and repeat the chest CT in two months

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。气管支气管结核确实要鉴别，但诊断要靠痰和支气管镜标本的涂片、培养、分子检测和病理（ATS/IDSA/CDC 2017 结核病诊断指南）。没有证据就开始数月的抗结核治疗，会让她承受肝毒性等风险，并把真正的诊断推迟两个月以上。
feedback.en: No. Tracheobronchial tuberculosis belongs in the differential, but the diagnosis rests on smear, culture, molecular testing and histology of sputum and bronchoscopic samples (ATS/IDSA/CDC tuberculosis diagnosis guideline, 2017). Months of empirical treatment expose her to hepatotoxicity and put the real diagnosis off by two months or more.

text.zh-CN: 长期刺激物接触所致的慢阻肺；长效支气管舒张剂治疗，3 个月后复查肺功能
text.en: COPD from long-term irritant exposure; long-acting bronchodilators, with lung function repeated in three months

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。她不吸烟，弥散量正常（占预计值 89.4%），固定性上气道阻塞图形又把问题定位在中心气道；慢阻肺累及小气道和肺实质，不会使气管壁增厚、钙化。按 ERS/ATS 2022 肺功能解读技术标准，单凭 FEV₁/FVC 降低分不出小气道和中心气道阻塞，必须看流量–容积环的形态。
feedback.en: No. She does not smoke, her diffusing capacity is preserved (89.4 % of predicted), and the fixed upper-airway pattern places the problem in the central airway; COPD affects the small airways and lung tissue and does not thicken and calcify the tracheal wall. Under the ERS/ATS 2022 interpretive standard a low FEV₁/FVC alone cannot tell small-airway from central-airway obstruction; the shape of the loop must be read.

prompt.zh-CN: 你准备做支气管镜。CT 示气管和多处大支气管广泛不均匀狭窄，肺功能为固定性上气道阻塞，她这个月又在咯血；心律记录示频发室性早搏和短阵室性心动过速，左心室射血分数 60%。你怎样安排这次支气管镜？
prompt.en: You plan a bronchoscopy. The CT shows widespread uneven narrowing of the trachea and multiple large bronchi, the lung function a fixed upper-airway obstruction, and she has been coughing blood again this month; her rhythm record shows frequent ventricular premature beats with short runs of ventricular tachycardia, and her LVEF is 60 %. How do you arrange the bronchoscopy?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 1，并调阅她的心律记录和左心室射血分数记录。
need.en: First answer decision 1 and read her heart rhythm record and ejection fraction record.

text.zh-CN: 先查血常规、凝血和妊娠状态，再由介入呼吸团队和麻醉医生在全身麻醉下操作，备好硬质支气管镜、止血手段、心电监护和除颤仪
text.en: Blood count, clotting and pregnancy status first, then general-anaesthetic bronchoscopy by the interventional team and an anaesthetist, with a rigid bronchoscope, bleeding control and ECG monitoring with a defibrillator

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。CT 和肺功能提示的广泛中心气道狭窄意味着支气管镜本身就可能堵住残余管腔，活检后的出血或水肿可迅速造成窒息，所以操作要放在能立即建立并维持气道的条件下：全身麻醉、硬质支气管镜和喷射通气、止血手段，由介入团队和麻醉医生共同实施（中华医学会呼吸病学分会良性中心气道狭窄介入诊治专家共识，2017）。她有频发室早和短阵室速（ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南要求查找其结构性心脏病病因），麻醉中要持续心电监护并备好除颤仪；活检前先核查血常规、凝血和妊娠状态。
feedback.en: Correct. Widespread central narrowing on CT and lung function means the scope itself may occlude what lumen remains, and bleeding or swelling after a biopsy can quickly cause asphyxia, so the procedure belongs where the airway can be secured at once: general anaesthesia, a rigid bronchoscope with jet ventilation and bleeding control, run by the interventional team with an anaesthetist (Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis, 2017). Her frequent ectopy and runs of VT, which the ESC ventricular arrhythmia guideline (2022) asks to be investigated for structural heart disease, call for continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator ready during the anaesthetic, and the blood count, clotting and pregnancy status are checked before any biopsy.

text.zh-CN: 按常规在内镜室做可弯曲支气管镜：咪达唑仑清醒镇静，鼻导管吸氧和指脉氧监测，在最窄的一段多点钳夹活检，以尽量提高诊断阳性率
text.en: A routine flexible bronchoscopy in the endoscopy suite under midazolam conscious sedation, with nasal oxygen and pulse oximetry, taking several forceps biopsies from the narrowest segment to maximise the diagnostic yield

feedback.zh-CN: 不对，这正是本例最危险的选择。镇静会削弱维持狭窄气道开放的自主呼吸，可弯曲镜进入严重狭窄段可能完全堵塞管腔，在这样狭窄的气道里钳夹活检引起的出血几分钟内就能致命，而内镜室没有硬质支气管镜和喷射通气可以抢救。2017 年良性中心气道狭窄介入诊治专家共识（中华医学会呼吸病学分会）主张这类狭窄在全身麻醉下、备好硬质支气管镜处理。
feedback.en: No — this is the dangerous choice. Sedation can remove the breathing effort that keeps a narrowed airway open, a flexible scope pushed into a severe stenosis may occlude it completely, and bleeding from forceps biopsies in so narrow an airway can kill within minutes, with no rigid bronchoscope or jet ventilation in the endoscopy suite to rescue her. The Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis (2017) manages such narrowing under general anaesthesia with a rigid bronchoscope ready.

text.zh-CN: 先在局部麻醉下做择期气管切开，确保通气之后，再经气切口送入可弯曲支气管镜，对狭窄段取活检
text.en: An elective tracheostomy under local anaesthesia first, to secure her ventilation before anything else, then a flexible bronchoscopy through the stoma with biopsies of the narrowed segments

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。气管切开只能绕过造口以上的气道，她的狭窄累及气管和多处大支气管，造口以下的狭窄段依旧，活检出血仍会流进远端气道。在病因不明时先做外科气道并不能保证安全；诊断和再通都可以在全身麻醉下用硬质支气管镜完成（中华医学会呼吸病学分会良性中心气道狭窄专家共识，2017）。
feedback.en: No. A tracheostomy bypasses only the airway above the stoma; her narrowing involves the trachea and multiple large bronchi, so the stenosis below the stoma remains and blood from a biopsy can still flood the distal airway. A surgical airway before the cause is known adds risk without securing her, whereas rigid bronchoscopy under general anaesthesia can both diagnose and recanalise (Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis, 2017).

text.zh-CN: 暂缓一切气道操作，先请心内科用胺碘酮负荷数周压住室性早搏和短阵室速，等心律稳定以后再安排支气管镜
text.en: Postpone all airway procedures and have cardiology load amiodarone over several weeks to suppress the ventricular ectopy and runs of tachycardia, then arrange the bronchoscopy once her rhythm has settled

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南对频发室早和非持续性室速的要求，是查找结构性心脏病（超声心动图，必要时心脏磁共振）并纠正电解质紊乱；她的射血分数为 60%，没有理由把一个正在进展的气道狭窄搁置数周。胺碘酮负荷不是这种情况的常规处理：请心内科同步评估，并在麻醉期间持续心电监护、备好除颤仪。
feedback.en: No. For frequent ventricular ectopy and non-sustained VT, ESC 2022 asks for a search for structural heart disease (echocardiography, and cardiac MRI where needed) and correction of electrolytes; with an ejection fraction of 60 % there is no reason to leave a progressing airway stenosis for weeks. Amiodarone loading is not the routine answer here: involve cardiology in parallel and keep her on continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator during the anaesthetic.

text.zh-CN: 不做支气管镜，镜子通过这么窄、又在出血的气道太危险：根据 CT 和全身 PET-CT 作出临床诊断，直接开始治疗
text.en: No bronchoscopy, since passing a scope through so narrow and bleeding an airway is too dangerous: make a clinical diagnosis from the CT and a whole-body PET-CT and start treatment on that basis

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。CT 和 PET-CT 都不能确定管壁病变的性质：结核、肿瘤、复发性多软骨炎和其他浸润性疾病可以表现相似，治疗却截然不同。面对危险的气道，办法不是放弃取材，而是在能控制气道和出血的条件下取材（中华医学会呼吸病学分会良性中心气道狭窄专家共识，2017）。
feedback.en: No. Neither CT nor PET-CT can name a disease of the airway wall: tuberculosis, tumour, relapsing polychondritis and other infiltrative diseases can look alike and are treated in entirely different ways. The answer to a dangerous airway is not to forgo tissue but to take it where the airway and bleeding can be controlled (Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis, 2017).

prompt.zh-CN: 支气管镜见气道黏膜广泛增生，管腔最窄处约为正常管径的 10%，黏膜易出血。活检病理：无定形物质，刚果红染色阳性，λ 轻链强阳性。在判定为局限于气道、而不是系统性的病变之前，哪些评估是必需的？（多选）
prompt.en: Bronchoscopy showed extensive mucosal proliferation along the airway, at its narrowest about 10 % of the normal calibre, with mucosa that bleeds easily. The biopsy shows amorphous material that is Congo red positive and strongly positive for λ (lambda) light chain. Before you call this disease confined to the airway rather than systemic, which assessments are needed? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 2，并调阅之后的检查记录。
need.en: First answer decision 2 and read the records that follow it.

text.zh-CN: 用质谱（或免疫电镜）在组织中确认淀粉样蛋白的类型，而不只依靠轻链染色
text.en: Confirm the amyloid protein type in the tissue by mass spectrometry (or immunoelectron microscopy) rather than by light-chain staining alone

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。轻链免疫组化可能误导，分型错了治疗就会错；质谱（或免疫电镜）是最可靠的分型方法（中国系统性轻链型淀粉样变性诊断和治疗指南，2021）。λ 强阳性提示 AL λ 型，但仍需确认。
feedback.en: Needed. Light-chain immunohistochemistry can mislead, and a wrong type means the wrong treatment; mass spectrometry (or immunoelectron microscopy) is the most reliable typing method (Chinese AL amyloidosis guideline, 2021). The strong λ staining suggests AL λ but needs confirming.

text.zh-CN: 血清和尿免疫固定电泳加血清游离轻链及 κ/λ 比值，并做骨髓穿刺和骨髓活检
text.en: Serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains and the κ/λ ratio, plus a bone marrow aspirate and trephine biopsy

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。单做免疫固定电泳可能漏掉克隆：AL 筛查要把血、尿免疫固定电泳和血清游离轻链合在一起看，并用骨髓检查评估克隆性浆细胞（中国系统性轻链型淀粉样变性诊断和治疗指南，2021）。
feedback.en: Needed. Immunofixation alone can miss a clone: the AL screen combines serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains, and a marrow examination assesses the clonal plasma cells (Chinese AL amyloidosis guideline, 2021).

text.zh-CN: NT-proBNP、肌钙蛋白和含应变分析的超声心动图或心脏磁共振（她有室性心律失常），并查尿蛋白和肝功能
text.en: NT-proBNP, troponin and echocardiography with strain or cardiac MRI — she has a ventricular arrhythmia — plus urine protein and liver tests

feedback.zh-CN: 需要。心脏受累决定 AL 淀粉样变的预后和治疗；她有频发室早和短阵室速，要用 NT-proBNP、肌钙蛋白和心脏影像排除心肌淀粉样变（ESC 2021 心脏淀粉样变立场声明；ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南）。射血分数 60% 不能排除心脏受累。
feedback.en: Needed. Cardiac involvement drives prognosis and treatment in AL amyloidosis; with frequent ventricular ectopy and runs of VT, cardiac amyloid must be excluded with NT-proBNP, troponin and cardiac imaging (ESC position statement on cardiac amyloidosis, 2021; ESC ventricular arrhythmia guideline, 2022). An ejection fraction of 60 % does not exclude it.

text.zh-CN: 全身 PET-CT 分期：如果气道以外没有高代谢病灶，就可以排除系统性受累
text.en: Whole-body PET-CT staging: if nothing outside the airway is metabolically active, systemic involvement is excluded

feedback.zh-CN: 不需要，它也回答不了这个问题。PET-CT 不是淀粉样变的检查，阴性结果不能排除心脏、肾脏或骨髓受累；是否系统性要看克隆筛查和器官评估（中国系统性轻链型淀粉样变性诊断和治疗指南，2021）。
feedback.en: Not needed, and it cannot settle the question. PET-CT is not a test for amyloid, and a negative scan does not exclude cardiac, renal or marrow involvement; whether the disease is systemic is decided by the clonal screen and organ assessment (Chinese AL amyloidosis guideline, 2021).

text.zh-CN: 首先做 TTR 基因测序，因为合并室性心律失常的淀粉样变应首先考虑遗传性转甲状腺素蛋白型
text.en: TTR gene sequencing first, because amyloidosis with a ventricular arrhythmia should be presumed to be the hereditary transthyretin type

feedback.zh-CN: 不是首选。λ 轻链强阳性提示 AL 型，应先在组织中确认类型；只有分型显示转甲状腺素蛋白（ATTR）时才需要 TTR 基因检测（ESC 2021 心脏淀粉样变立场声明）。室性心律失常可见于任何类型的心脏淀粉样变，并不指向遗传型。
feedback.en: Not first. Strong λ staining points to AL; the type is confirmed in the tissue first, and TTR sequencing follows only if typing shows transthyretin (ESC position statement on cardiac amyloidosis, 2021). Ventricular arrhythmias occur in any type of cardiac amyloidosis and do not point to the hereditary form.

prompt.zh-CN: 血清和尿免疫固定电泳均未见单克隆条带；尿蛋白阴性，肝肾功能正常，左心室射血分数 60%。骨髓检查没有做，血清游离轻链、心脏标志物和组织分型都没有结果记录。最窄的气道段约为正常管径的 10%。你的治疗计划是什么？
prompt.en: Serum and urine immunofixation show no monoclonal band; urine protein is negative, liver and renal function are normal and the LVEF is 60 %. No bone marrow examination was done, and no serum free light chain, cardiac biomarker or tissue-typing result is recorded. The narrowest airway segment is about 10 % of the normal calibre. What is your treatment plan?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 3，再调阅之后回报的评估结果。
need.en: First answer decision 3, then read the assessment results that come back after it.

text.zh-CN: 按局限于气道的病变处理：分次硬质支气管镜再通，复发时考虑放疗；补齐全身评估，证实系统性 AL 前不用化疗
text.en: Treat it as airway-confined disease: staged rigid bronchoscopic recanalisation, radiotherapy if it recurs; complete the systemic screen, with no chemotherapy unless it proves systemic AL

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。现有资料没有发现循环中的单克隆蛋白或器官受累，按局限性 AL 淀粉样变处理：局部治疗，不用全身化疗（BSH 2015 AL 淀粉样变治疗指南）；局限性 AL 很少进展为系统性（Mahmood 等，Lancet Haematol 2015）。最窄处约 10% 的气道需要尽快在全身麻醉下用硬质支气管镜再通，弥漫或复发的病变可考虑外照射放疗；同时补做游离轻链、心脏标志物和影像、组织分型和骨髓检查，以确认这一判断。
feedback.en: Correct. With no circulating monoclonal protein or organ involvement found, she is managed as localised AL amyloidosis — local treatment and no systemic chemotherapy (BSH AL management guideline, 2015); localised AL rarely progresses to systemic disease (Mahmood et al., Lancet Haematol 2015). An airway narrowed to about 10 % needs prompt rigid bronchoscopic recanalisation under general anaesthesia, with external-beam radiotherapy an option for diffuse or recurrent disease, while the free light chains, cardiac biomarkers and imaging, tissue typing and marrow are completed to confirm the judgement.

text.zh-CN: 在支气管镜治疗的同时给予美法仑联合沙利度胺全身化疗，从源头抑制产生轻链的克隆，阻止沉积在她的气道里再次形成
text.en: Systemic melphalan with thalidomide alongside the bronchoscopic treatment, to suppress the light-chain-producing clone at its source and so stop the deposits from re-forming in her airway

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。这接近报告当年的做法——在支气管镜治疗之外还使用了全身药物——但她的记录里没有证据证明系统性 AL。化疗只用于确诊的系统性 AL，目前的一线方案是达雷妥尤单抗联合硼替佐米、环磷酰胺和地塞米松（EHA-ISA 2023），不是美法仑联合沙利度胺。美法仑有骨髓毒性，可致卵巢功能衰竭和继发白血病；沙利度胺致畸，可能怀孕的女性必须纳入妊娠预防计划。
feedback.en: No. This is close to what the report records — systemic drugs as well as the bronchoscopic treatment — but nothing in her records establishes systemic AL. Chemotherapy is for proven systemic AL, where current first-line treatment is daratumumab with bortezomib, cyclophosphamide and dexamethasone (EHA-ISA 2023), not melphalan with thalidomide. Melphalan is myelotoxic and can cause ovarian failure and secondary leukaemia; thalidomide is teratogenic and needs a pregnancy-prevention programme in a woman who could become pregnant.

text.zh-CN: 在气管和双侧主支气管放置自膨式金属支架作为确定性治疗，一次撑开全部狭窄段，免得她反复做操作
text.en: Self-expanding metallic stents in the trachea and both main bronchi as the definitive treatment, opening every narrowed segment at once and sparing her repeated procedures

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。非恶性气道狭窄放置金属支架是最后的手段：肉芽增生、支架断裂、移位和取出困难都很常见，因此美国 FDA（2005 年良性气道疾病金属气管支架公共卫生通告）和中华医学会呼吸病学分会良性中心气道狭窄专家共识（2017）都主张其他办法用尽后才考虑。她的狭窄范围广，病变还可能再长，支架代替不了分次再通。
feedback.en: No. In non-malignant airway narrowing metallic stents are a last resort — granulation, fracture, migration and very difficult removal are common — which is why the US FDA (2005 notification on metallic tracheal stents in benign airway disorders) and the Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis (2017) keep them for when other options are exhausted. Her narrowing is extensive and can regrow, so stents cannot replace staged recanalisation.

text.zh-CN: 局限性淀粉样变很少进展为系统性：暂不干预，每 6 个月复查肺功能和胸部 CT，病情加重时再治疗
text.en: Localised amyloidosis rarely becomes systemic, so no intervention for now, with lung function and a chest CT every six months and treatment only if she deteriorates

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。局限性 AL 确实很少进展为系统性（Mahmood 等，2015），但她的问题是只剩约 10% 管腔的气道、加重的憋气和咯血，现在就需要恢复通畅，而不是观察；中华医学会呼吸病学分会良性中心气道狭窄专家共识（2017）对有症状的严重狭窄主张经支气管镜介入治疗。
feedback.en: No. Localised AL does rarely become systemic (Mahmood et al., 2015), but her problem is an airway reduced to about 10 % of its calibre with worsening breathlessness and bleeding, which needs restoring now rather than watching; the Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis (2017) treats symptomatic severe stenosis by bronchoscopic intervention.

text.zh-CN: 转胸外科切除病变的气管节段，行端端吻合重建，一次手术把异常管壁彻底切除
text.en: Refer to thoracic surgery for resection of the diseased tracheal segment with end-to-end reconstruction, removing the abnormal wall completely in one operation

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。病变累及气管和多处大支气管，没有一个节段能切干净，弥漫病变的长度也超出了能安全切除的范围；外科切除只适合局限的短段狭窄（中华医学会呼吸病学分会良性中心气道狭窄专家共识，2017）。
feedback.en: No. The disease involves the trachea and multiple large bronchi, so no single segment can be resected clear, and diffuse disease exceeds the length that can be removed safely; resection suits a short, localised stenosis (Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis, 2017).

text.zh-CN: 问清 10 年来痰中带血的规律、本月的复发和出血量、半年来憋气的发展、能否平卧、有无发热、呼吸杂音和体重变化
text.en: Established the ten-year pattern of blood-streaked sputum, its return this month and the amount, the six-month course of breathlessness, lying flat, fever, noisy breathing and weight

text.zh-CN: 询问以往心律问题、吸烟饮酒、刺激物接触、结核病史、长期用药、过敏和妊娠可能
text.en: Asked about earlier heart-rhythm problems, smoking and alcohol, irritant exposure, tuberculosis, regular medicines, allergies and possible pregnancy

text.zh-CN: 听诊和叩诊双肺，检查气管位置、杵状指、下肢水肿和浅表淋巴结
text.en: Auscultated and percussed the chest and checked the trachea, finger clubbing, leg oedema and superficial lymph nodes

text.zh-CN: 操作前调阅胸部 CT、肺功能、心律记录和射血分数，并开出血常规与凝血、妊娠试验
text.en: Before the procedure, read the chest CT, lung function, rhythm record and ejection fraction, and ordered a blood count with clotting screen and a pregnancy test

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把阻塞定位于气管支气管壁的病变，并选择经支气管镜取材
text.en: Placed the obstruction in disease of the tracheobronchial wall and chose bronchoscopic sampling, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择有气道抢救条件的取材方案，并在入院评估阶段实际转介介入呼吸团队行全麻支气管镜
text.en: Chose a sampling plan with airway rescue at the first attempt and, during the admission assessment, actually referred her for bronchoscopy under general anaesthesia by the interventional team

text.zh-CN: 没有让她在内镜室清醒镇静下做可弯曲支气管镜活检
text.en: Did not send her for flexible bronchoscopic biopsy under conscious sedation in the endoscopy suite

text.zh-CN: 调阅支气管镜和活检记录、免疫固定电泳和骨髓检查结果，并开出血清游离轻链和心脏标志物
text.en: Read the bronchoscopy and biopsy records and the immunofixation and bone marrow results, and ordered serum free light chains and cardiac biomarkers

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即说出判定病变局限于气道之前所需的分型、克隆筛查和器官评估
text.en: Named the typing, clonal screen and organ assessment needed before calling the disease confined to the airway, at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择局部治疗，在看到结局记录之前预约硬质支气管镜再通，并请血液科和心内科参与
text.en: Chose local treatment at the first attempt, booked rigid bronchoscopic recanalisation before seeing the outcome record, and involved haematology and cardiology

text.zh-CN: 没有给予经验性抗结核治疗、哮喘吸入剂、全身化疗或金属支架
text.en: Gave no empirical anti-tuberculosis treatment, asthma inhalers, systemic chemotherapy or metallic stents

text.zh-CN: 用她听得懂的话解释检查和治疗计划，取得知情同意，并如实说明仍不确定的部分
text.en: Explained the tests and the treatment plan in words she understands, obtained consent, and was honest about what remains uncertain

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 良好表现（Calgary–Cambridge：开始接诊、采集信息、解释与计划、结束）：自我介绍，先问她自己怎么理解这次住院，回应她“想弄清楚是什么病、还能不能喘顺气”的担心；用通俗的话说明气管和大支气管的管壁有病变、把通道变窄了，要在全身麻醉下由能随时打开气道的团队用支气管镜看清楚并取一小块组织，说明出血和气道方面的风险并取得知情同意；在麻醉、造影剂或任何可能致畸的药物之前，私下、得体地询问末次月经和怀孕的可能。拿到病理后，用日常语言解释“淀粉样物质”（一种异常蛋白沉积），说明目前的检查提示病变局限于气道，但游离轻链、骨髓和心脏检查还没做完，所以这个判断仍是暂定的；解释为什么治疗以疏通气道为主、可能需要反复做，以及为什么现在不用化疗；交代出现咳血增多或呼吸明显加重时要立即求助。用复述法确认她听懂了，留出提问时间。不编造病例中没有的检查结果或预后数字。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering information, explaining and planning, closing): introduces themselves, first asks how she understands why she is in hospital, and responds to her wish to know what this is and whether she will breathe properly again; explains in plain words that the walls of her windpipe and main airways are diseased and have narrowed the passage, and that a team able to keep her airway open will look inside under general anaesthesia and take a small sample, with the bleeding and airway risks explained and consent obtained; before anaesthesia, contrast or any drug that could harm a pregnancy, asks privately and tactfully about her last period and whether she could be pregnant. Once the biopsy is back, explains 'amyloid' in everyday words (an abnormal protein deposit), that the tests so far suggest it is confined to the airway but the light-chain, marrow and heart tests are not complete, so this is still provisional; explains why treatment centres on opening the airway and may need repeating, and why chemotherapy is not being used now; tells her to seek help at once if she coughs more blood or her breathing worsens. Checks understanding with teach-back and leaves time for questions. Invents no result or prognostic figure the case does not record.

name.zh-CN: 乔护士

knowledge.zh-CN: 交班（ISBAR）：42岁女性，间断咯血 10 年、憋气半年，近 1 个月憋气加重并再次咯血，收入病房；能平卧，此次无发热。病房床旁有监护仪、除颤仪和抢救车，护士站有病历终端；血和尿标本在床旁采集送检，做 CT 或磁共振要把患者送到影像科；支气管镜、手术室和介入操作通过介入呼吸团队预约。复述医嘱并完成护理范围内的工作；只报告已经回来的结果，不解读、不诊断。被问到生命体征、血氧或化验数值时，如实说没有记录可报，绝不报出数字。
knowledge.en: Handover (ISBAR): a 42-year-old woman with ten years of intermittent haemoptysis and six months of breathlessness, worse over the past month when the haemoptysis returned, admitted to the ward; she can lie flat and has had no fever this time. On the ward: bedside monitors, a defibrillator and the crash cart, with a records terminal at the nurses' station; blood and urine samples are taken at the bedside and sent; for CT or MRI the patient goes to imaging; bronchoscopy, theatre and interventional procedures are booked through the interventional pulmonology team. Reads orders back and does nursing-scope tasks; reports only results that are back, never interprets or diagnoses. Asked for vital signs, oxygen saturation or blood results, says plainly there is nothing recorded to report — never gives a number.

name.zh-CN: 严医生（呼吸内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“固定性上气道阻塞在流量–容积环上是什么形状？为什么它把问题指向中心气道？”“弥散量正常排除了什么？”“哪些疾病会让气管支气管壁增厚、钙化？”“镇静和一根支气管镜遇上一条严重狭窄、近期咯血的气道，会发生什么？”“她的室性心律失常对操作安排意味着什么？”“这份病理证明了什么、没有证明什么？”“射血分数正常能排除心脏受累吗？”“什么证据才足以支持全身治疗？”。可以讲解 ERS/ATS 2022 肺功能解读、2017 年良性中心气道狭窄专家共识、中国 AL 淀粉样变指南（2021）、BSH 2015、EHA-ISA 2023、ESC 2021 心脏淀粉样变立场声明和 ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南的相关原则；学员读到结局记录之后，可以把报告的做法（多次硬质支气管镜治疗、气管切开和全身药物同时使用）与现行做法对照。不提前说出诊断或任何决策的正确选项；不补充病例没有的资料（生命体征、血氧、出血量、血常规和凝血、游离轻链、心脏标志物、组织分型、骨髓、心脏影像细节、各项治疗的时间和全身药物的方案都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about information the learner already has, e.g. “What shape does a fixed upper-airway obstruction give the flow–volume loop, and why does it point to the central airway?”, “What does a normal diffusing capacity argue against?”, “Which diseases thicken and calcify the tracheobronchial wall?”, “What happens when sedation and a bronchoscope meet a severely narrowed airway that has recently bled?”, “What does her ventricular arrhythmia mean for how the procedure is set up?”, “What does this biopsy prove, and what does it leave open?”, “Does a normal ejection fraction exclude cardiac involvement?”, “What evidence would justify systemic treatment?”. May explain the relevant principles of the ERS/ATS 2022 interpretive standard, the 2017 Chinese consensus on benign central airway stenosis, the Chinese AL guideline (2021), BSH 2015, EHA-ISA 2023, the ESC 2021 position statement on cardiac amyloidosis and ESC 2022 on ventricular arrhythmias, and — once the learner has read the outcome record — contrast the reported course (repeated rigid bronchoscopic treatment, a tracheostomy and systemic drugs together) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or a decision's correct option before the learner commits, and adds nothing the case lacks (vital signs, oxygen saturation, the amount of bleeding, blood count and clotting, free light chains, cardiac biomarkers, tissue typing, marrow, cardiac imaging detail, the timing of each treatment and the drug regimen are not recorded).

name.zh-CN: 石医生（介入呼吸科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 介入呼吸科医生，接到转介后参与。只解读学员已经读过的胸部 CT、肺功能和支气管镜记录：流量–容积环的固定性、可变性胸内和胸外阻塞图形；为什么严重中心气道狭窄要在全身麻醉下、备好硬质支气管镜和喷射通气处理；镇静和可弯曲镜在这种气道里的风险；机械清除、电烧灼、冷冻、氩等离子体凝固等再通方法各自的特点；为什么非恶性狭窄尽量不放金属支架；以及放疗在弥漫或复发病变中的位置。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造病变分布、气管后壁膜部是否受累、取材部位、治疗次数或并发症（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Interventional pulmonologist who joins once she is referred. Interprets only the chest CT, lung function and bronchoscopy records the learner has read: the fixed, variable intrathoracic and variable extrathoracic patterns of the flow–volume loop; why severe central narrowing is handled under general anaesthesia with a rigid bronchoscope and jet ventilation ready; the risks of sedation and a flexible scope in such an airway; what mechanical debulking, electrocautery, cryotherapy and argon plasma coagulation each offer; why metallic stents are avoided in non-malignant narrowing; and where radiotherapy fits for diffuse or recurrent disease. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents the distribution of disease, posterior-wall involvement, biopsy sites, the number of treatments or complications (none is recorded).

name.zh-CN: 秦医生（血液科）

knowledge.zh-CN: 血液科医生，接到会诊后参与。只解读学员已经读过的活检病理、免疫固定电泳、尿蛋白、肝肾功能和骨髓检查记录：刚果红染色和偏振光下苹果绿双折光的意义；轻链免疫组化的局限和质谱分型；局限性与系统性 AL 淀粉样变的区别；为什么 AL 筛查要把血、尿免疫固定电泳和血清游离轻链合在一起看并查骨髓；心脏受累的评估（NT-proBNP、肌钙蛋白、超声应变、心脏磁共振）和分期；系统性 AL 的现行一线治疗；以及局限性病变为什么不用化疗、如何随访。不报告学员尚未读到的结果；不编造游离轻链、骨髓、分型或心脏检查的结果（都没有记录）。
knowledge.en: Haematologist who joins once consulted. Interprets only the biopsy, immunofixation, urine protein, liver and renal function and bone marrow records the learner has read: what Congo red staining and apple-green birefringence under polarised light mean; the limits of light-chain immunohistochemistry and typing by mass spectrometry; localised versus systemic AL amyloidosis; why the AL screen combines serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains and a marrow examination; how cardiac involvement is assessed (NT-proBNP, troponin, echocardiographic strain, cardiac MRI) and staged; current first-line treatment of systemic AL; and why localised disease is not treated with chemotherapy and how it is followed. Never reports a result the learner has not read, and never invents free light chain, marrow, typing or cardiac results (none is recorded).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：弥漫性气管支气管淀粉样变——定位阻塞、安全取材，再分清局限性与系统性
title.en: Debrief: diffuse tracheobronchial amyloidosis — locating the obstruction, sampling it safely, and telling localised from systemic disease

conclusion.zh-CN: 弥漫性气管支气管淀粉样变性伴严重中心气道狭窄。42岁女性，间断痰中带血 10 年、憋气半年并在近 1 个月加重；胸部 CT 示气管及多处大支气管管壁不规则增厚、钙化，管腔广泛不均匀狭窄；流量–容积环呈固定性上气道阻塞（FEV₁ 1.45 L，占预计值 55.7%；FEV₁/FVC 50.77%；弥散量占预计值 89.4%）。支气管镜见黏膜广泛增生、易出血，最窄处约为正常管径的 10%；活检刚果红阳性、λ 强阳性。血、尿免疫固定电泳无单克隆条带，尿蛋白阴性，肝肾功能正常，LVEF 60%；但没有做骨髓检查，频发室早和短阵室速的原因也没有记录。报告联合使用多次硬质支气管镜治疗、气管切开和全身药物：7 个月后拔除气切套管，FEV₁ 升至 1.71 L，11 个月时无憋气和咯血。现行做法：在全身麻醉、备好硬质支气管镜的条件下取材，完成分型和全身评估（游离轻链、骨髓、心脏标志物和心脏影像），局限性病变局部治疗，不用化疗。
conclusion.en: Diffuse tracheobronchial amyloidosis with severe central-airway stenosis. A 42-year-old woman with ten years of intermittent blood-streaked sputum and worsening breathlessness had thickened, calcified, widely narrowed tracheobronchial walls on CT and a fixed upper-airway pattern (FEV₁ 1.45 L, 55.7 % predicted; FEV₁/FVC 50.77 %; diffusing capacity 89.4 %). Bronchoscopy showed friable mucosal proliferation, narrowest at about 10 % of normal; the biopsy was Congo red positive and strongly λ positive. Immunofixation, urine protein, liver and renal tests and LVEF (60 %) were normal; no marrow examination or cause for her ventricular ectopy is recorded. The report combined rigid bronchoscopic treatment, a tracheostomy and systemic drugs; the tube came out after 7 months, FEV₁ rose to 1.71 L, and at 11 months she had no breathlessness or haemoptysis. Today: sample under general anaesthesia with rigid-bronchoscope backup, complete typing and the systemic assessment (free light chains, marrow, cardiac biomarkers and imaging), and treat localised disease locally, without chemotherapy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 十年反复痰中带血、半年进行性憋气，不吸烟、无发热、体重稳定，查体无啰音和杵状指：这是一个慢性、进展缓慢的气道问题，先要找出阻塞在哪里。
keyReasoning.en: Ten years of recurrent blood-streaked sputum and six months of progressive breathlessness in a non-smoker without fever, weight loss, crackles or clubbing: a chronic, slowly progressive airway problem — first find where the obstruction is.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 固定性上气道阻塞图形加上正常的弥散量，指向中心气道；CT 上气管和大支气管管壁增厚、钙化、广泛狭窄，说明病变在管壁本身，需要组织学诊断。
keyReasoning.en: A fixed upper-airway pattern with a normal diffusing capacity points to the central airway; thickened, calcified, widely narrowed tracheal and bronchial walls on CT put the disease in the wall itself, which needs a tissue diagnosis.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 取材之前先考虑气道：广泛狭窄、近期咯血，再加上室性心律失常，意味着要全身麻醉、硬质支气管镜、止血手段和心电监护，并先查血常规、凝血和妊娠状态。
keyReasoning.en: Before sampling, think of the airway: widespread narrowing, recent bleeding and a ventricular arrhythmia mean general anaesthesia, a rigid bronchoscope, bleeding control and ECG monitoring, with blood count, clotting and pregnancy status checked first.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 刚果红阳性加 λ 强阳性提示 AL 型淀粉样沉积；免疫固定电泳阴性、尿蛋白阴性、肝肾功能正常支持局限性，但缺少游离轻链、骨髓、心脏评估和组织分型，这一判断只能是暂定的。
keyReasoning.en: Congo red positivity with strong λ staining suggests AL amyloid; negative immunofixation, negative urine protein and normal liver and renal function favour localised disease, but without free light chains, marrow, cardiac assessment and typing the judgement stays provisional.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 治疗跟着这个判断走：局限于气道的病变用局部方法恢复通畅，复发时可考虑放疗；只有证实系统性 AL 才用化疗。
keyReasoning.en: Treatment follows that judgement: disease confined to the airway is opened by local means, with radiotherapy for recurrence; chemotherapy is only for proven systemic AL.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 看流量–容积环，而不只看 FEV₁/FVC。FEV₁/FVC 50.77% 只说明存在阻塞；吸气和呼气两支同时出现平台的固定性上气道阻塞图形，加上正常的弥散量（占预计值 89.4%），才把阻塞定位到中心气道。ERS/ATS 2022 肺功能解读技术标准把这种形态当作要用影像和内镜证实的线索，而不是诊断。记录与现行做法：本例的 CT 和肺功能已经把问题指向气管支气管壁，按现行做法下一步就是在安全条件下取材。
teachingPoints.en: Read the flow–volume loop, not just FEV₁/FVC. A ratio of 50.77 % shows obstruction; the fixed upper-airway pattern — plateaus in both inspiration and expiration — with a preserved diffusing capacity (89.4 % of predicted) locates it in the central airway. The ERS/ATS 2022 interpretive standard treats this shape as a pointer for imaging and endoscopy to confirm, not as a diagnosis. Then and now: her CT and lung function already pointed at the tracheobronchial wall, and today's next step is to sample it safely.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 严重中心气道狭窄要先保证气道再取材。管腔最窄处约 10%、黏膜易出血时，可弯曲镜和清醒镇静可能直接导致窒息；中华医学会呼吸病学分会 2017 年良性中心气道狭窄介入诊治专家共识主张在全身麻醉下、由介入团队备好硬质支气管镜和止血手段处理。合并频发室早和短阵室速（按 ESC 2022 要查找结构性心脏病）时，麻醉中持续心电监护、备好除颤仪。记录与现行做法：报告记录了多次硬质支气管镜治疗；她第一次检查是怎样做的，本病例没有记录。
teachingPoints.en: Secure the airway before sampling a severe central stenosis. With a lumen of about 10 % at its narrowest and friable mucosa, a flexible scope under conscious sedation can cause asphyxia; the Chinese Thoracic Society consensus on benign central airway stenosis (2017) manages such narrowing under general anaesthesia by an interventional team with a rigid bronchoscope and bleeding control ready, and frequent ectopy with runs of VT, to be investigated for structural heart disease (ESC 2022), adds continuous ECG monitoring with a defibrillator during the anaesthetic. Then and now: the report records repeated rigid bronchoscopic treatment; how her first examination was done is not recorded in this case.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 刚果红阳性证明是淀粉样物质，λ 强阳性提示 AL λ 型，但类型最好用质谱（或免疫电镜）在组织中确认；免疫固定电泳阴性也不能排除克隆，AL 筛查要把血、尿免疫固定电泳和血清游离轻链合在一起看，并做骨髓检查（中国系统性轻链型淀粉样变性诊断和治疗指南，2021）。记录与现行做法：本例做了免疫固定电泳，但没有记录游离轻链和组织分型，也没有做骨髓检查。
teachingPoints.en: Congo red positivity proves amyloid and strong λ staining suggests AL λ, but the type is best confirmed in the tissue by mass spectrometry (or immunoelectron microscopy); negative immunofixation does not exclude a clone either, so the AL screen combines serum and urine immunofixation with serum free light chains and a marrow examination (Chinese AL amyloidosis guideline, 2021). Then and now: immunofixation was done, but no free light chains or typing are recorded and the marrow was not examined.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 淀粉样变患者出现频发室早和短阵室速时，射血分数 60% 不能排除心脏受累：ESC 2021 心脏淀粉样变立场声明要求结合 NT-proBNP、肌钙蛋白和心脏影像（超声应变或心脏磁共振）评估，ESC 2022 室性心律失常指南也要求对频发室早和非持续性室速查找结构性心脏病。记录与现行做法：本例只记录了射血分数，没有记录其他心脏评估。
teachingPoints.en: In a patient with amyloid, frequent ventricular ectopy and runs of VT are not explained away by an ejection fraction of 60 %: the ESC 2021 position statement on cardiac amyloidosis assesses NT-proBNP, troponin and cardiac imaging (echocardiographic strain or cardiac MRI), and ESC 2022 asks for a search for structural heart disease in frequent ectopy or non-sustained VT. Then and now: only the ejection fraction is recorded; no other assessment of the heart is.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 局限性 AL 淀粉样变按局部病变治疗：硬质支气管镜下机械清除、电烧灼和冷冻分次再通，弥漫或复发的病变可考虑外照射放疗；全身化疗只用于确诊的系统性 AL（BSH 2015 AL 淀粉样变治疗指南），而系统性 AL 现行的一线方案是达雷妥尤单抗联合硼替佐米、环磷酰胺和地塞米松（EHA-ISA 2023）。记录与现行做法：报告在多次硬质支气管镜治疗之外还做了气管切开、使用了全身药物（提及美法仑和沙利度胺）；7 个月后拔除气切套管，FEV₁ 从 1.45 L 升至 1.71 L，11 个月时无憋气和咯血，但几种治疗叠加，无法判断哪一项起了作用。按现行做法，系统性 AL 未被证实时不用化疗，沙利度胺用于可能怀孕的女性还必须纳入妊娠预防计划。
teachingPoints.en: Treat localised AL amyloidosis locally: staged rigid bronchoscopic recanalisation with mechanical debulking, electrocautery and cryotherapy, and external-beam radiotherapy for diffuse or recurrent disease; chemotherapy is for proven systemic AL only (BSH AL management guideline, 2015), where current first-line treatment is daratumumab with bortezomib, cyclophosphamide and dexamethasone (EHA-ISA 2023). Then and now: the report added a tracheostomy and systemic drugs (melphalan and thalidomide are named) to repeated rigid bronchoscopic treatment; after 7 months the tube came out and FEV₁ rose from 1.45 to 1.71 L, and at 11 months she had no breathlessness or haemoptysis — but with the treatments combined, no single one can be credited. Today chemotherapy is not given while systemic AL is unproven, and thalidomide in a woman who could become pregnant also needs a pregnancy-prevention programme.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。几种治疗同时进行，无法判断各自的疗效，也不能据此推断局限性气道淀粉样变的一般预后。病例没有记录生命体征、血氧、出血量、血常规和凝血、游离轻链、心脏标志物、组织分型、心脏影像细节和各项治疗的时间；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. Several treatments were given together, so the effect of each cannot be judged, and nothing general about the prognosis of localised airway amyloidosis follows from it. No vital signs, oxygen saturation, amount of bleeding, blood count or clotting, free light chains, cardiac biomarkers, tissue typing, cardiac imaging detail or treatment timing is recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.
